title: Archive completed todos
probes: The full chain on a genuinely new capability spanning both repos: PO scoping, Architect spec, Coder TDD, QA plan, automation, docs, one PR per repo.
description:
As a todo user I want completed items to move out of my way so that my list stays short without losing history.

Today `complete` only flips `done: true` and the item stays in the file forever. Add an archive concept:

- A new CLI command `todo archive` moves every completed todo into an archive so it no longer appears in `list --all`.
- `todo archive --list` shows what has been archived.
- The web view keeps showing only live todos; add `?archived=1` to see the archive.

Archived todos must survive a restart and must never be silently deleted.
